newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile June-August unemployment down slightly.
newsitem.headline: Chile June-August unemployment down slightly.

text.p: Chile's unemployment rate fell to seven percent in the June-August quarter, down 0.1 percent from the May-July period, said the National Statistics Institute.
The figures are not comparable with the same period last year as the government has recently changed the way it collects the statistics.
Areas with the highest unemployment include the central Fifth Region and southern Eighth Region, with jobless rates of 7.6 percent and 7.3 percent respectively.
The sparsely populated southern Eleventh Region reported the lowest unemployment level at just 1.1 percent.
